## Symptom
The live Jira DC lane (jira-dc-harness in external-integration.yml) fails on two rich-text tests AFTER change 2266 (bug f449 lag-free snapshot overlay) landed:

1. test_live_rich_text_renders_and_echo_is_safe — after _push_and_converge of a rich body, renderedFields.description is EMPTY (''), so the <h1> assertion fails (test_dc_rich_text_live.py:179). The converged check passed (weak oracle), but nothing rich landed.
2. test_live_rich_text_both_sides_conflict_keeps_local — the baseline settle pass (a converged repeat) computed outbound totals [1] when a converged repeat must compute nothing (test_dc_rich_text_live.py:241).

## Prior state (ground truth)
Before 2266, BOTH tests failed ONLY at the now-removed _wait_until_search_reflects timeout (240s); the search index held description:None for >240s while the write succeeded. So on DC these assertions (render + echo) never actually executed before — 2266 removed the wait and revealed/introduced these two failures.

## Hypothesis to investigate
The f449 overlay (snapshot_lagfree_refresh.overlay_lagfree_scalars) overwrites curr_snapshot[key]['description'] with a DIRECT-GET raw value, changing the description's provenance/shape vs the JQL-search snapshot the rich-text echo-safety (story 3388) normalization was validated against. This may (a) break the codec normalization so a converged repeat re-pushes (symptom 2), and (b) alter first-push bidirectional suppression (3bf8) so inbound-wins and the rich body never lands (symptom 1). Alternatively these are pre-existing DC cutover bugs the search-wait masked.

## Acceptance
Root cause proven (offline repro via real differ code with simulated lagging snapshot), fix restores DC-lane green for both tests, no regression to Cloud lane or f449 unit oracle.
